name: framer-thumnbails
title: Framer Thumbnail Carousel
blurb: Carousel with collapsible thumbnail strip; selected thumbnail expands, others…
description: Image carousel with compact horizontal thumbnail navigation. Selected thumbnail displays at full width; unselected ones collapse to narrow strips. Click thumbnails to navigate and expand.
use_when: Image galleries where space efficiency and thumbnail preview are both important.
avoid_when: When all thumbnails need equal visibility.
a11y: Click handlers on thumbnails; no keyboard navigation exposed.
